```python
"""
Hollow Cylinder — 30 mm outer diameter, 20 mm tall, 10 mm through-hole.

A simple cylindrical sleeve / spacer with a central through-hole.
"""

import cadquery as cq

MODEL_DESCRIPTION = "Hollow cylinder: Ø30 mm outer, Ø10 mm inner hole, 20 mm tall."

MODEL_DETAILS = {
    "purpose": "A cylindrical sleeve or spacer with a central through-hole.",
    "key_dimensions": {
        "outer_diameter": "30 mm",
        "height": "20 mm",
        "hole_diameter": "10 mm",
    },
    "intended_use": "General-purpose spacer, bushing, or stand-off.",
    "assumptions": "Z-up, origin at bottom center. All dimensions are user-specified.",
    "interaction_notes": "No parametric dependencies. Single solid body.",
    "manufacturing_or_placement_constraints": "Suitable for 3D printing or CNC turning.",
}

REFS = {
    "type": "part",
    "features": {
        "outer_cylinder": "The outer cylindrical wall of the hollow cylinder.",
        "central_hole": "The 10 mm through-hole running the full height.",
    },
}


def build(params=None):
    outer_d = 30.0
    height = 20.0
    hole_d = 10.0

    result = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(outer_d / 2)
        .extrude(height)
        .faces(">Z")
        .workplane()
        .circle(hole_d / 2)
        .cutThruAll()
    )
    return result
```
